items.text: A place for every age and stage.
From the nursery to the college years and beyond, there is a place for you and your family at Faith Christian Center.
Birth through 5th grade. High energy, Bible-based fun every Sunday.
Youth groups for tweens and teens, every Wednesday night.
College students and young adults, gathering for fellowship.
Men growing in faith and brotherhood together.
Women encouraging one another in faith and friendship.
Small groups that meet through the week. Do life together.
Serve on a team and use your gifts for God's glory.
